$comment: Source of truth for the two Log Analytics custom tables. Read by src/notify/findings.py (via tests), terraform/module-azure-o11y and scripts/deploy.sh. Column types use DCR stream spelling (datetime, not dateTime); converters map them for the Tables API. Add columns only at the end; never rename or retype one (see docs/agents/findings.md).

O11yOpsFindings_CL.description: Ops findings: a resource whose metric is at or above its hot threshold over the Ops lookback. One row per (resource, metric) on every Ops run (OPS_SCHEDULE_CRON) while the condition holds.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Run time (UTC); end of the evaluated window

columns.name: RunId
columns.description: Unique id of the function run that wrote the row

columns.name: ManagementGroupId
columns.description: Management group whose thresholds were applied

columns.name: ResourceId
columns.description: Full ARM resource id

columns.name: ResourceName
columns.description: Resource name

columns.name: ResourceType
columns.description: ARM resource type, lower case (e.g. microsoft.compute/virtualmachines)

columns.name: SubscriptionId
columns.description: Subscription id

columns.name: ResourceGroup
columns.description: Resource group name

columns.name: Location
columns.description: Azure region

columns.name: Sku
columns.description: Current SKU / size (e.g. Standard_D4s_v5)

columns.name: MetricNamespace
columns.description: Azure Monitor metric namespace

columns.name: MetricName
columns.description: Azure Monitor metric name (e.g. Percentage CPU)

columns.name: MetricKey
columns.description: Config key of the metric (e.g. cpu); matches the o11y-threshold-<key>-hot tag

columns.name: Unit
columns.description: Unit of ObservedValue and Threshold (e.g. Percent)

columns.name: Aggregation
columns.description: How ObservedValue was computed from the metric series (e.g. average)

columns.name: ObservedValue
columns.description: Observed value over the window; out of range when >= Threshold

columns.name: Threshold
columns.description: Hot threshold that was breached

columns.name: ThresholdSource
columns.description: config (thresholds YAML) or tag (per-resource o11y-threshold-* tag)

columns.name: WindowStart
columns.description: Start of the evaluated window (UTC)

columns.name: WindowEnd
columns.description: End of the evaluated window (UTC)

columns.name: LookbackMinutes
columns.description: Length of the Ops window

columns.name: Owner
columns.description: owner tag (email); empty when missing

columns.name: AssignmentGroup
columns.description: assignment_group tag; empty when missing

columns.name: AssignmentGroupEmail
columns.description: Team email from config/assignment-groups.yaml; empty when the group is missing or unmapped

columns.name: CarId
columns.description: car_id tag (application id); empty when missing

columns.name: MissingTags
columns.description: Ownership tags that are missing or unmapped, e.g. ["owner"]

columns.name: Tags
columns.description: All resource tags at run time

columns.name: PortalUrl
columns.description: Azure portal link to the resource

O11yFinOpsFindings_CL.description: FinOps findings: a resource whose percentile utilization over the FinOps lookback is below its cold threshold, with a downsizing recommendation and estimated saving. One row per resource per daily FinOps run (FINOPS_SCHEDULE_CRON); use the latest RunId (or arg_max by ResourceId) for current state.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Run time (UTC); end of the evaluated window

columns.name: RunId
columns.description: Unique id of the function run that wrote the row

columns.name: ManagementGroupId
columns.description: Management group whose thresholds were applied

columns.name: ResourceId
columns.description: Full ARM resource id

columns.name: ResourceName
columns.description: Resource name

columns.name: ResourceType
columns.description: ARM resource type, lower case (e.g. microsoft.compute/virtualmachines)

columns.name: SubscriptionId
columns.description: Subscription id

columns.name: ResourceGroup
columns.description: Resource group name

columns.name: Location
columns.description: Azure region

columns.name: Sku
columns.description: Current SKU / size (e.g. Standard_D8s_v5)

columns.name: OsType
columns.description: Linux or Windows; drives pricing

columns.name: MetricNamespace
columns.description: Azure Monitor metric namespace

columns.name: MetricName
columns.description: Azure Monitor metric name (e.g. Percentage CPU)

columns.name: MetricKey
columns.description: Config key of the metric (e.g. cpu); matches the o11y-threshold-<key>-cold tag

columns.name: Unit
columns.description: Unit of ObservedValue and Threshold (e.g. Percent)

columns.name: Aggregation
columns.description: Per-interval aggregation of the metric series (e.g. average)

columns.name: Granularity
columns.description: Interval of the metric series (ISO 8601, e.g. PT1H)

columns.name: Percentile
columns.description: Percentile taken over the interval values (e.g. 95)

columns.name: ObservedValue
columns.description: Observed percentile value; out of range when < Threshold

columns.name: Threshold
columns.description: Cold threshold the value is below

columns.name: ThresholdSource
columns.description: config (thresholds YAML) or tag (per-resource o11y-threshold-* tag)

columns.name: WindowStart
columns.description: Start of the evaluated window (UTC)

columns.name: WindowEnd
columns.description: End of the evaluated window (UTC)

columns.name: LookbackDays
columns.description: Length of the FinOps window

columns.name: DataCoverage
columns.description: Fraction (0-1) of expected datapoints present in the window

columns.name: RecommendedSku
columns.description: Suggested smaller SKU; empty when no safe target exists

columns.name: Confidence
columns.description: high, medium or low

columns.name: Reason
columns.description: Why the row exists and how the recommendation was derived

columns.name: CurrentMonthlyCost
columns.description: Retail pay-as-you-go monthly price of Sku; null when unpriced

columns.name: ProjectedMonthlyCost
columns.description: Retail monthly price of RecommendedSku; null when unpriced or no target

columns.name: EstimatedMonthlySaving
columns.description: CurrentMonthlyCost - ProjectedMonthlyCost; null when either is missing

columns.name: Currency
columns.description: Currency of the cost columns (e.g. USD)

columns.name: Owner
columns.description: owner tag (email); empty when missing

columns.name: AssignmentGroup
columns.description: assignment_group tag; empty when missing
